messages:
maya: Short sync from the postmortem: recurring cache thrash pattern -> we need concrete test additions and owners. Aim: stop regressions from sneaking into prod.
kevin: I'll build a focused regression suite for KV cache lifecycles (warm, cold, partial eviction). Expect initial PR in 14 days.
sanjay: I'll own chaos drills and a network-latency scenario. Plan: runbook + one automated drill against staging, then quarterly on prod-slice. Target: runbook draft in 7 days, automation in 21.
eva: For evals I will add two prompt sets that showed degraded outputs during the incident. Need the golden outputs and a short extraction script. @maya can you paste examples?
maya: Pasted snippets here: 
- "summarize: user query with long context -> missing last paragraph"
- "rewrite: instruction loses list items when KV miss occurs"
Also linking incident: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-21-cache-thrash|incident-2026-03-21>.
apsara: Suggest adding a lightweight nightly load job against a small dedicated slice labelled `nightly/incidents-smoke`. Cap concurrency at 80 to be safe. I can land CI job in 48h.
devops: We'll need `svc-chaos-runner` with limited RBAC and a vault token scoped to staging-only for initial runs. I can provision in 48h once owners confirm.
kevin: Regression PR checklist proposal: data source, minimal repro, expected metric thresholds, CI tag `regression-cache`, and a rollback link. I'll draft the checklist and open an RFC PR tomorrow.
sanjay: Chaos scenarios: 1) intermittent packet loss 2) CPU noise on workers 3) eviction race simulation. Run against canary and a tiny dedicated pool. I'll coordinate with @lucy for staging windows.
eva: Proposed eval thresholds: semantic sim (sbert_cos) >= 0.86, exact-token-overlap >= 0.68, and a fail-on-delta rule if score drops >6% vs baseline. These are adjustable after first run.
maya: Also add an alert rule: if nightly-incidents-smoke shows 10% increased tail latency or eval fails, open a P0 ticket and tag `oncall`.
apsara: I'll add the `nightly/incidents-smoke` job under `ci/jobs/` and mark it `non-blocking` for deploys. PR incoming in 48h.
devops: Created ticket to provision service account and RBAC: INF-5643. Assigning to @devops.
kevin: Owners summary: regression suite -> @kevin (14d), chaos drills -> @sanjay (21d for automation), prompt evals -> @eva (10d), nightly load -> @apsara (48h), RBAC -> @devops (48h).
lucy: I'll approve staging windows once SANJAY sends the specific schedule. Also +1 to quarterly drills.
oncall-bot: Reminder: retro doc due in 3 days for incident-2026-03-21.
maya: OK let's reconvene next Wed 9am PT to check progress. Please tag all PRs with `incident-1842134567` and add the `regression-cache` CI tag when applicable. Thanks!
